## How to Pronounce RAQSAPI

Initially, the name `RAQSAPI` started as an acronym. So Technically RAQSAPI should be pronounced by spelling out the name of
the project, R-A-Q-S-A-P-I. As time went on I noticed that a lot of people not familiar with AQS, R or air monitoring had
trouble remembering the entire acronym. Often times people not familar with the project would pronounce it as "rækˈsæpi"
([IPA phonetic pronunciation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Phonetic_Alphabet) pronounced as "rack" + "sappy").
Instead of correcting people on how the authors thought it should be pronounced, RAQSAPI has adopted both as acceptable ways
to pronounce the project's name. "R-A-Q-S-A-P-I" or [rækˈsæpi ("rack" + "sappy")] as acceptable.
